rationale.consistency: Uses cmdutil.FlagErrorf and existing query patterns, but imports `testing` into a production package, mixes 'failed to upload'/'could not upload' phrasing, and handles nil Config differently in commentable vs create/edit.
rationale.edge_cases: Covers dup files via os.SameFile, empty/'-' values, size/type/dir/empty checks and refusal ordering; but partial uploads are still written (spec says nothing written on failure), and a failed upload sets Body.Edited=false, silently dropping a user-supplied --body on edit.
rationale.scope: Feature wired everywhere asked, but carries dead code (isSingleImage, UploadStub, unused *testing.T param, KeepExistingBody always true) and extra behaviours (inline video→link degrade, reference-video refusal) not requested.
rationale.readability: references.go is ~600 lines of hand-rolled byte scanning over source instead of using goldmark segments; client.go is a long status-code ladder; the same '%w\n%w' wrap block is repeated ~10 times.
rationale.robustness: CommentableRun calls opts.Config() with no nil guard; create/edit swallow config errors and surface a misleading 'unsupported authentication type'; findMatchingArg does os.Stat per candidate during markdown rewriting; NewTestAssets chdirs globally.
rationale.maintainability: Upload/error plumbing is copy-pasted across six commands, hasDeferredFlags is duplicated in issue edit, and the custom markdown span-finder is fragile to any CommonMark edge case goldmark already handles.
